candidates.statement: Inventory's Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations 503s, which propagate as order ReadTimeouts and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry (server latency, saturation, connection errors) not observed; root cause within Redis (load vs. network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) in inventory, inventory 503s on /v1/reservations, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s with p95 ~2425ms. Inventory metrics show 503s on /v1/reservations and readyz. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Order deployment record is baseline only and does not establish causation.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics/logs (latency, CPU, connections, timeouts) to confirm Redis as the failing dependency
Inventory logs for the reserve_inventory timeout window
